name: statechart
description: Check a TLA+ model of a system that moves between states with TLC, and draw it as a Mermaid statechart that shows the shortest path to each state that breaks a rule. Adapted from the statechart skill in poteto's pstack (Lauren Tan, MIT). Adds a setup script that needs no mise, a Pele render script, and a method for modelling code you maintain: fixed-commit models, one dead end per round, and a state space small enough that every rule is checked.
